@AGENTS.md

# CVApp

## Template stills must be regenerated by hand

The landing page and `/templates` do not render CVs. They show captured
stills from `public/templates/<template-id>.png`, because fourteen live
documents on one page cost about 2,000 DOM elements and made both pages drag.

**Anything that changes how a template looks also changes those files.**
Nothing regenerates them for you, and no test can tell that a still has gone
stale — the unit test only proves a file exists.

Re-run the capture, with `bun run dev` already serving on port 3001:

```
bun run thumbnails
```

Do that in the same change, and commit the PNGs with it, whenever you touch:

- a template's CSS in `public/cv/` or its definition in `components/cv/templates/`
- shared CV rendering: `components/cv/CvDocument.tsx`, the section renderers,
  `public/cv/base.css`
- the demo CV in `lib/schema/demo.ts`
- paper geometry in `lib/print/paper.ts`
- fonts or accents that a template takes as its default

Adding a template means adding its still, or its card renders as a blank white
box. `bun run test` fails when a registered template has no file at all.

The proof sheet at `/no/preview` still renders every template live. That is
what the capture script reads, so keep it working — it is the source the
stills come from, not a leftover.
